title: SOMA Auth: enable GitHub sign-in
_note: Selectors not yet checked against the live page (Supabase was signed out on 2026-11-03). Run sign-in.guide.json first if needed. Pass --param CLIENT_ID=<GitHub app Client ID>; the secret is never prefilled.

steps.instruction: Turn on Enable Sign in with GitHub.
Go to the GitHub tab, copy the new client secret (the copy icon next to it), come back, and paste it into Client Secret.
Yeshie filled in the Client ID from your GitHub app. Check it matches the GitHub tab, then click Save.
